claims.assertion: Yazhi says terrestrial civilizations repeatedly flourish and collapse in roughly 5,000–10,000-year cycles, and attributes humanlike morphology to ancient Lyrian peoples.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says cycle lengths vary elsewhere.

claims.assertion: Yazhi argues history branches across timelines, with no single linear past, and says nonhuman records inform her alternative account.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi alleges the Cabal destroyed historical records, while claiming many Alexandria-library manuscripts survive in the Vatican library.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as preserved hidden history.
